reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and I would only go a couple of times a month. It looks lovely, but I would not commit to a membership before I have seen the place.
objection: $59 a month for unlimited when I would use it maybe twice a month, and the free options already fill most of our week.
would_change_my_mind: A pay-as-you-go option I could try first, like a 5-visit pack around $40, or a work-friendly morning where I can really get some laptop time in.
